task: N2.6 bounded new-input qualification and contract-candidate trial
registration: Before inspecting remaining queue identities, new parent bodies, child messages/diffs, adapted-checker outputs or model answers. Existing selection code/schema and N2.5 method baseline were inspected.
purpose: Test whether the bounded candidate-generation and source-checking route is useful beyond the observed development example. Complete qualification, adequate parent-only trials and post-prediction source adjudication in one batch; do not promise two positive/normal samples.

selection.queue_rules: Reuse the two queues, implementation/header priorities and ranking of that stage without changing seed or adding keywords. Recompute remaining order after documented exclusions; choose one per queue, maximum two, no quota transfer or replacement after selection.
selection.audit: Before selecting, update commit/source/family contact from existing protocol, selection, metadata and exposure records. A hash in a metadata list alone is not source contact. All 500 have DeepSeek screening contact. No global-unseen claim. Existing explicit deferred/family/development sets remain excluded.
selection.late_contact: Disclose exact parent-file/function overlap and isolate formal independence if discovered later. No replacement. Known common background is distinguished from prior exposure to the target changed/provider mechanism; do not silently relabel known target code as independent.

collection.initial: For each selected exact single parent collect at most two matched public implementation files and at most two corresponding public headers, prioritizing the registered path order. Save complete bytes, Git identity and failures.
collection.supplement: After initial parent review, register at most one direct-symbol location search per case, at most six exact symbols, followed by at most two provider/consumer implementation files and two authority/config headers. Maximum eight complete files per case. No recursive helper expansion or new network fetch.
collection.adequacy: A trial requires a visible architecture-conditioned provider, common-use consumer, object/condition relation and plausible first-use or interface-requirement question. Missing key bodies means insufficient qualification and no model call. Do not require an actual bug to qualify or infer normality from no finding.
collection.parent_first: No child message/diff before each parent prediction/failure/skipped-call reason is saved. Then read only the two selected child messages/diffs for independent scope/oracle review; do not replace or change predictions.
collection.source_exposure: Use old exposure provenance and bounded exact-file/function comparison where prior source-body reading is documented. Report the limits; metadata selection or a new hash is not proof of a new causal mechanism.

adaptation_before_new_bodies.changes_allowed: New stage harness only. Source identity supports exact original Git file bytes at a named parent, or a verified complete-function slice located by the existing preparation_eligibility collector. Material-group IDs replace the two hardcoded runtime-profile labels. They do not certify architecture/configuration/legality.
adaptation_before_new_bodies.raw_layer: Documents are explicitly raw_source_file, with configuration/image/preprocessed identities null. Preserve all directives and original lines. Do not relabel them configured_function or strip instrumentation/branches.
adaptation_before_new_bodies.lexical_checks: Reuse unchanged complete_function from preparation_eligibility_20261016/collect_sources.py and unchanged _lex/_function_body/_anchor from the N2.5 checker. Convert whole-file anchors to the unique complete function's local coordinates and retain original coordinates. Unsupported locator, directives or calls stay insufficient. No C grammar, CFG, effect or normality support expansion.
adaptation_before_new_bodies.citations: Reuse exact document/hash/line-span binding principles. Material identity, source layer and case parent must match; no configured-readiness feature export.
adaptation_before_new_bodies.validation: Before new parent source bodies, test raw-byte and parent/material identity, exact slices and line conversion, wrong function/multiple definitions/directives, casts/nested arguments and preservation of semantic-insufficient markers. Save adapted harness/core digests before source trial; no repairs after seeing selected-case checker outcomes.

model.accounting: Visible counters and reservation separate; internal recovery/billing unknown. Do not assert platform-enforced billing cap.
model.input: Exact parent complete files, neutral source-scope/configuration limitations and bounded candidate schema. No selected title, screening answer, child/repair/outcome or researcher oracle. Manual material choices disclosed.
model.delivery: Nonempty final, success/exit0, matching model and only normal end reasons. Preserve incomplete/refused output; no refusal continuation, rewording recovery or format retry.
model.credential: Existing external credential in process memory/environment only, no project/ignored-directory key.

evaluation: Separate candidate qualification, new target-source exposure, same-family status, parent prediction, program-supported local facts and independent post-prediction scope judgment. Shared background or citation success is not an independent positive or a normal proof. No accuracy estimate from this purposive batch; same-material/same-budget baseline is subsequent registered work.
exit: Save deterministic selection, source/independence qualification, actual model/check/oracle results where adequate and explicit skipped reasons otherwise; update daily log and Windows/WSL current notes. Do not stop merely after metadata if authorized bounded source work can proceed.
